headline: Ultra-low latency Telehealth Voice AI built for Bharat in just 10 days
summary: Arogya Seva is an empathetic, multilingual, real-time voice assistant for health access in India. It interacts naturally in Indian English, Hindi, and regional scripts, addressing low-literacy users.
details: Arogya Seva is an empathetic, multilingual, real-time voice assistant built in 10 days for India's #VoiceForBharat challenge. It interacts naturally in Indian English, Hindi (Devanagari), and regional scripts, targeting non-tech-savvy or low-literacy users.

The system uses LiveKit Agents SDK, with Deepgram Nova-3 for real-time Speech-to-Text and Google Gemini 2.0 Flash for intent processing and clinical guardrails. Murf Falcon provides ultra-low latency, human-like Text-to-Speech.

Strict guardrails ensure safety, including a Red-Flag Clinical Emergency Protocol that urges callers to dial 108 for acute trauma. Native script enforcement ensures proper acoustic synthesis for Hindi responses, avoiding "Hinglish."

The Next.js frontend with LiveKit Agents UI displays real-time agent states like listening, thinking, and speaking with dynamic audio visualizers. Privacy-first memory with explicit consent allows saving basic details, with users able to wipe records via "Forget me."

It integrates real-domain health tools for symptom triage (Self-Care, Consult Nurse, Red-Flag) and finding nearest Primary Health Centres. Tool chaining reuses caller memory, and graceful failure provides emergency helplines if APIs are unreachable.
Outbound telephony for reminders includes a mandatory two-sentence opening stating the caller, purpose, and opt-out method. Users can instantly opt-out by saying "stop calling me" or pressing 9.
For situations exceeding AI scope, human escalation is available. The agent requests permission to create an escalation ticket, storing a sanitized summary and returning a unique reference ID.

Call analytics track structured metrics like duration, triage classifications, escalation status, and resolution codes. A multi-agent specialist handoff allows dynamic transfer to specialized agents, like a Clinic Appointment Specialist, without dropping the call.
caption:

headline_marked: [[user-scanner replaces Sherlock & Holehe]] with a 2-in-1 OSINT suite for digital footprinting
headline: user-scanner replaces Sherlock & Holehe with a 2-in-1 OSINT suite for digital footprinting
summary: user-scanner unifies email and username scanning, replacing fragmented OSINT workflows. It adds automated target pivoting and breach intelligence correlation, streamlining digital footprinting.
details: user-scanner is a new 2-in-1 OSINT suite designed to replace legacy tools like Sherlock and Holehe. It aims to eliminate fragmented, slow, and high-friction workflows by providing a unified engine for digital footprinting and target enumeration.

The suite combines the functionalities of email checks and username scans, which previously required separate tools. It extracts handles, links, and secondary email addresses directly from profile bios and metadata.

Beyond simple 'Found / Not Found' results, user-scanner automatically classifies link trust (handle, verified, link) and rates hit confidence (confirmed, likely, candidate, conflicting). Users can also restrict recursion depth for precise, high-precision searches.

A key feature is its ability to cross-reference targets against global infostealer malware infection logs, powered by Hudson Rock, all within the same run. This provides comprehensive breach intelligence correlation.

For developers and security agents, the engine can be called directly from Python, allowing for custom automation pipelines. The project is available on GitHub, encouraging users to integrate and contribute.
caption:
